Container.Name: block-buddy
Container.Overview: A kid-friendly page that builds what you describe in a Minecraft Bedrock world. Claude designs the build, and Block Buddy turns it into vanilla commands sent through your itzg Bedrock server console. No mods, and cheats can stay off.
Container.Requires: An itzg/minecraft-bedrock-server container created with -it in Extra Parameters, so the server has a console. An Anthropic API key. Keep Block Buddy on your LAN and do not port-forward it: the Docker socket lets this container control Docker on the host.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: minecraft bedrock build kids claude anthropic itzg blocks builder
Container.Changes: ### 2026-10-09 - First Unraid template. Web UI on port 8090, Docker socket, Anthropic API key, server list, optional PIN, and model.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Browser port for the Block Buddy page.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Required. Block Buddy sends build commands to your Bedrock containers through Docker. Do not expose this app to the internet.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: From console.anthropic.com. Used to design each build.

Config.Name: Servers
Config.Description: Comma-separated Display name=container name pairs. The container name must match the Bedrock container exactly.

Config.Name: PIN
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the page asks for it once and remembers it on that device.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Claude model. Sonnet is the default. An Opus model makes fancier builds, more slowly, and costs more.
